info.title: Hasna Accounts Capacity API
info.description: Owner-scoped, non-SaaS Accounts capacity metadata. This API does not issue leases or expose credential material.

post.description: Creates brokered_secret or workload_identity intent only. Native ceremony is rejected.
Non-reservational diagnostic only; never acquires or issues a lease.
Safe signed receipt metadata only; raw handles are excluded.

capacityBearer.description: Separately audienced Hasna capacity credential; legacy profile keys are rejected.
